title: World Liquor 0.1.148 — exact pairing with Tavern 0.6.170
native_evidence_scope: Dependency and release-identity pairing only. World Liquor gameplay and presentation are unchanged. Tavern editor arithmetic warning verification does not establish complete World Liquor client or family acceptance.
public_notes_inline:
Known issue: Treasure Guide's mob bonus can copy unrelated newly dropped items; overlapping death callbacks can multiply bonus drops. This release retains the existing behavior; no fix is included. Reproduced against W148 source in an isolated mocked scheduler, not a native-server reproduction.

已知風險：淘金熱（Treasure Guide）的生物掉落加成仍以死亡位置附近的新物品判定，可能誤複製玩家剛丟出的物品或其他生物的掉落；重疊死亡回呼可能放大額外掉落。本版保留現有行為，未包含此問題的修補。此問題已在目前 W148 原始碼的隔離模擬中重現，尚非原生伺服器實測。

Use both World Liquor 0.1.148 packs with both Tavern 0.6.170 packs. The optional Grilling source-check peer is 2.8.149. Gameplay, recipes, storage, models, textures and materials are unchanged by this pairing. The stable release uses source/editor, strict CI and exact package evidence; it does not claim complete Java parity. Additional real-client, install/upgrade/restart/rollback, saved-world and soak acceptance are unverified and are not gates for this publication. Existing strict CI remains required. Client acceptance, production readiness and live deployment remain false; historical runtime evidence is not reassigned to this family.
